derivedRules.weeklyCellColour: OBSERVED on every cell of 4 periods (0 violations): value 0 → "-" bg-slate-50 text-slate-300; M1 > 0 → bg-blue-50 text-blue-700; later week > previous cell (a 0 previous counts) → bg-green-50 text-green-700; < previous → bg-red-50 text-red-600; = previous (> 0) → bg-blue-50 text-blue-700; the maximum cell also gets ring-2 ring-amber-400 ring-inset (no ties observed).
derivedRules.weeklyTrend: OBSERVED: last week vs the week before: > Meningkat (fa-arrow-up text-green-500), < Menurun (fa-arrow-down text-red-500), = Sama (fa-minus text-slate-400).
derivedRules.weeklyBest: OBSERVED: "M{n}" + max value; "-" when all weeks are 0.
derivedRules.weeklyRowOrder: OBSERVED: total answered descending, ties by school id ascending (33 rows = the 33 pelajar-table schools).
derivedRules.s3PillRules: OBSERVED from row x-show: Semua = all rows; Aktif = rows with >= 1 answer (includes "ditapis" and rows without a login), label count n = S3 "Pernah Aktif" (excludes ditapis) → label/rows mismatch; Login sahaja = no answer AND has login; Belum login = no login (includes answered rows without a login). A row whose name contains an apostrophe throws an Alpine error and shows under every pill.
derivedRules.s5Cadangan: OBSERVED 8080: red box 1 n = students without any login (6 Belum login + 2 Aktif without login = 8); red box 2 n = Aktif students with accuracy < 50 (3); green box n = Aktif (174). Card Perlu Perhatian = non-Aktif (4 + 6 = 10).
derivedRules.s2Lists: OBSERVED: Sekolah Terbaik = up to 3 Cemerlang schools in table order; Perhatian Segera = every Rendah, Kritikal and Tiada Langsung school in table order; Cadangan: Kritikal → motivasi, Tiada Langsung with 0 teacher logins → Hubungi, Tiada Langsung with >= 1 teacher login → hands-on (+ "(Nota: n guru telah login)" on the Perhatian line), Rendah → no Cadangan.
derivedRules.subscriptionPill: OBSERVED: "Active — sehingga d MMM yyyy" bg-green-100 text-green-700; "Cancelled — sehingga …" and "Expired — sehingga …" bg-slate-100 text-slate-500; no subscription → plain text "Tiada langganan" text-xs text-slate-400.
derivedRules.warningBox: OBSERVED: shown when flagged accounts > 0; the sentence "{d} daripadanya dikecualikan dari peratus penglibatan kerana corak seperti automasi." only when excluded (ditapis) > 0 (8087: 3 akaun, 10220: 1 akaun without it).
